spec2def(olethk32.dll olethk32.spec)

# olethk32.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/olethk32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
add_cargo_module(olethk32 olethk32-cargo olethk32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
